title: Nie mamy już na grę
description: Po przegranej Owczar po prawej pokazuje już wyciągniętą pustą podszewkę kieszeni. Dariusz po lewej reaguje współczująco, bez wyśmiewania. Nie stać ich na kolejną grę; nie deklarujemy braku wszystkich drobnych, bo później kupują tanią oranżadę. Propozycja dialogu do osobnego nagrania: Owczar: „Masz na jeszcze jedną?” Dariusz: „Kurde, też już nie mam”. 4 s.

prompts.image: Use case: sketch-to-render / photorealistic-natural. Create ONE final live-action film still, 16:9, ideally 1920x1080. Input 1 is a WORKING BLENDER RENDER, strictly a camera, spatial layout, scale and composition reference, NOT the final visual style. Input 2 is a SMALL PERSPECTIVE/BLOCKING GUIDE of the same camera: its converging lines explain real spatial directions and its primitive figures mark human placement. Do not reproduce the guide, linework, captions, faceted bodies, plastic surfaces or crude geometry. Rebuild the visible scene as a convincing photographed physical place while retaining the prescribed viewpoint, major dimensions, openings, object positions and framing. Improve natural material variation, construction details, contact shadows and realistic light; do not redesign the layout or invent different architecture. No game-engine look, no illustration, no split panels, no watermark. Early-1990s provincial Polish atmosphere, understated cinematic realism and restrained film grain, no modern products. Input 3 is the exact production identity and wardrobe reference: Dariusz is the chubby red-brown wavy-haired boy with rectangular dark glasses on the LEFT of that reference; Owczar is the slim dark-blond boy in the burgundy track jacket on its RIGHT. Both are 13–14, clean-shaven. Preserve their specific faces, hair, age, body shape and clothing. Owczar has TWO cream stripes on each sleeve, ivory T-shirt, loose blue jeans and worn pale canvas trainers. Dariusz has an open grey-blue plaid overshirt, grey/navy striped T-shirt, dark loose jeans and dark worn trainers. Their positions in the final shot are dictated by the shot instructions, not by the identity reference layout. Replace all visible primitive stand-ins with anatomically natural boys, and insert the boys where requested even if the clean render is empty. No adult beard, no extra people. SHOT ACTION AND COMPOSITION: Two boys have stepped back from the cabinet. Reverse medium close two-shot: Dariusz on screen left, Owczar on screen right. Owczar checks an empty pocket; Dariusz looks at him with rueful amusement. No coins held up. Dim, close, slightly hazy basement arcade, motivated warm practical lights mixed with soft CRT illumination. Retain real cabinet artwork and its physical shapes. Exposure must keep faces readable where present; believable darkness, not uniformly bright room.  Input 4 is the completed opening shot: use it only to preserve the same physical cabinet finish, practical lighting and photographic treatment. Do not copy its viewpoint or body placement; the first two geometry references define THIS camera.

Camera: locked medium two-shot. @Image1 fixes the existing boys identities only. Preserve Start Frame clothes, positions, glasses, cabinet lettering and arcade lighting.
